title: My Fair Lady

lines.text: Love, is this the real thing?
How you looked at me
Pages of a magazine
Now you're on, always on my mind
Every color, life and feature
Never age and never tire
In my sleep and in my dreams at night
Calls to me, a strange attraction
Your beauty and your fashion
You are art and art will never change
A gray pencil mark is such a perfect imitation of
And as it seems, it seems you're almost here
Grey colour light and feature
Never age and never tire
In my sleep and in my dreams at night
Calls to me, a strange attraction
With your beauty and your passion
You are hard and hard will never change
You are just an illustration
This is just a simulation
Lines and pixels on a piece of paper
You can see me slowly changing
But forever you're remaining
You have time 'cause you will live forever
Should never age and never die
In my sleep and in my dreams at night
Close to me, a strange attraction
With your beauty and your passion
You are fun, and art will never change
